title: Shinsekai
notes: NEW: World Map with 5 regions. Region 1 Neo-Tokyo is everything so far. Region 2 YOMI, the Land of the Dead, is open; Takamagahara, Ryugu-jo and Mugen are coming soon.
Yomi unlocks at Master 99 + Kami Trial 3 + Rift depth 30: nine Circles of Yomi with 10 floors each, loot at your level with high rarity, Unique and Godforged drops from circle bosses.
NEW skill tree Shinigami Arts (Talents tab), paid with Soul Embers from Yomi, with the NEW active skill Shinigami Scythe (key F): three armor-piercing slashes on all enemies that reap weak foes.
No more one-shots: a normal enemy hit can take at most 50% of your max HP.
Paragon: opponents mostly gain HP (+5% per level) and only a little damage (+2%), and level up more slowly. Skill Mastery has no fixed cap after Master 99 (+1 per Paragon level).

Master League re-balanced: lifesteal heals at most 8% of your max HP per second against Masters, Paragon, Kami and Yomi (huge-damage builds healed to full on every hit). Now about 50 min at x3 with real fights.
Hero: hair rebuilt (no more floating spikes), a glowing ki aura around the hero, boots without the odd knee blobs.
Uniques can be salvaged (no auto-lock any more, still never auto-salvaged). NEW: Salvage all button in the bag.
